as_told.title: Disappearance of Jacobo Grinberg after lattice discovery

plain: A Mexican neurophysiologist and psychologist named Jacobo Grinberg vanished in the mid-1990s and was never found. A researcher guest, drawing on a documentary film about Grinberg, says it happened in 1995, "less than a month after" the death of the researcher Andrija Puharich, which would tie the two men's fates together. Michels tells it with a different date, saying Grinberg vanished in 1994 "just after his biggest discovery." In another telling Michels, crediting the researcher Alex Gomez-Marin, adds that Grinberg's last note was about how he had "figured it out," and then he was never seen again.
